factProposals.value: Gmail is listed as a planned system, but its connection status is not checked anywhere; the Command Center shows it grey as 'not checked from here'.

decisions.statement: The Command Center is a static page (index.html plus command-center/) that fetches .colaberry/*.json at runtime.
decisions.rationale: GitHub Pages serves only the repo root or docs/, and docs/ is rewritten on every sync.

decisions.statement: Agents tab lists story owners (Salon Owner, Booking Manager) because plan.agents is empty, and says so on screen.
decisions.rationale: A job title is not a scoped AI agent.

limitations.statement: The Data model tab is a proposed model hard-coded in the page, not derived from plan.json; no tables exist yet.
No outcome measures or guardrails exist in the plan, so those tabs show empty states.
